abstract: Maintains emergency courier response timetables and dry-shipper dispatch records
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic Cold-Chain Logistics Lead (LOG). Your business responsibility is to maintain emergency courier response timetables, dry-shipper dispatch records, and telemetric monitoring data for dedicated cryogenic transport fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency courier response timetables and dry-shipper dispatch records（DISP）
information_points.content:
LOG-DISP-T8W：For the Allschwil Bio-Depot Campus, dedicated cryogenic retrieval transport has an emergency courier dispatch window of 60 min, measured as the elapsed time between emergency call activation and the dispatch of a pre-conditioned dry shipper.
LOG-DISP-5UC：For the St. Johann Cryo-Vault Facility, dedicated cryogenic retrieval transport has an emergency courier dispatch window of 30 min, measured as the elapsed time between emergency call activation and the dispatch of a pre-conditioned dry shipper.
LOG-DISP-4I8：For the Muttenz Deep-Freeze Repository, dedicated cryogenic retrieval transport has an emergency courier dispatch window of 45 min, measured as the elapsed time between emergency call activation and the dispatch of a pre-conditioned dry shipper.

information_points.title: Fleet telemetric monitoring（TELEM）
information_points.content:
LOG-TELEM-YRB：Fleet telemetric monitoring records for the St. Johann Cryo-Vault Facility indicate a GPS telemetry ping frequency of 60 pings/h across its dedicated refrigerated transport fleet.
LOG-TELEM-AYI：Fleet telemetric monitoring records for the Allschwil Bio-Depot Campus show a GPS telemetry ping frequency of 24 pings/h across its dedicated refrigerated transport fleet.
LOG-TELEM-97M：Fleet telemetric monitoring records for the Muttenz Deep-Freeze Repository show a GPS telemetry ping frequency of 12 pings/h across its dedicated refrigerated transport fleet.
